title: One row of a lane's results.json
description: A production lane (r-n, r-s, r-b) or re-run lane (a-) writes results.json as a list of these rows, one per function in its batch, or as an object holding that list under `functions` or `results`. Fields are the ones the production brief (briefs/production.txt and brief_notes.json) asks for and the coordinator's scripts read (sync_rewrites.py, apply_counts.py through counts.py, release_failed.py, prod_report.py, review_metrics.py, the dashboard). Other fields are allowed. lane_results.py checks rows against this schema and only ever warns.

address.description: The function's original address: a hex string such as 0x00509FF0 (either case), or a number.

name.description: The merged symbol name if one exists, otherwise the lane's proposed descriptive name.

size.description: Size in bytes, from the repaired inventory.

outcome.description: What happened. The verified forms are scan.PASSED (sync_rewrites.py imports only those); deferred needs a reason; not_reached and not yet run (brief note 15: every row starts as not yet run) leave the function to be released; failed forms have been seen from re-run lanes.

reason.description: For a deferral, one code from the brief: indirect_call, thread_local, frame_pointer_args, runtime_table, float_register_args, jump_thunk, not_a_function, needs_encrypted_code, checker_gap (a defect shown on a private worker, brief note 7), other (explain in detail).

detail.description: Free text: what blocked it, or what the next lane should know.

trials.description: Trials run on the stock checker; at least 1,000 for a pass.

attempts.description: Attempts made (the brief caps them at 6).

minutes.description: Time spent on this function, in minutes, read from the clock.

checker.description: The checker version the result was produced under (the brief asks for v4).

brief.description: The production brief version (brief_notes.json `version`, or an experiment tag).

mutant_caught.description: Whether the deliberately wrong version failed under the same contract (AGENTS.md rule 3).

mutant.description: One phrase: what the wrong version changed.

narrowed.description: Everything that made this function's comparison narrower than the default (masked or skipped arguments, checks switched off, callees left native, raised call-log caps); empty when nothing.

private_worker.description: One line describing a private worker change, for a checker_gap deferral (brief note 7).

source_lane.description: For a re-run lane: the lane whose rewrite was re-run.

allOf.$comment: A deferral names its reason (release_failed.py keeps only deferrals with a reason assigned).
A pass carries what AGENTS.md rule 3 asks of it: trials, the wrong version's result (which must have been caught), what narrowed the proof, and the checker and brief versions.
